map.取肝、肺、肾、骨髓等脏器消化后镜检硅藻：生前溺死时溺液经肺入体循环，多脏器（尤其: Digest organs such as liver, lung, kidney and bone marrow and examine microscopically for diatoms: in ante-mortem drowning the drowning fluid enters the systemic circulation via the lungs, so diatoms appear in multiple organs (especially liver, kidney and bone marrow) with species matching the water at the scene; post-mortem submersion shows them only locally in lung/trachea with other organs negative. …
map.水中尸体溺死与死后入水鉴别: Differentiating ante-mortem drowning from post-mortem submersion
map.硅藻种类与水样一致性比对: Comparison of diatom species with the water sample
map.清水中硅藻少、腐败破坏、检验方法灵敏度不足均可致假阴性；应结合肺水肿、呼吸道血性: Few diatoms in clear water, decomposition and insufficient test sensitivity can all cause false negatives; combine with pulmonary oedema, blood-tinged airway foam and other findings — a negative result does not absolutely exclude drowning
map.硅藻阴性就能排除溺死吗？: Does a negative diatom test rule out drowning?
map.不能。清水中硅藻少、腐败破坏、检验方法灵敏度不足均可致假阴性；应结合肺水肿、呼吸: No. Few diatoms in clear water, decomposition and insufficient test sensitivity can all cause false negatives; combine with pulmonary oedema, blood-tinged airway foam and other findings — a negative result does not absolutely exclude drowning.
map.为什么看肝/肾/骨髓而不是只看肺？: Why look at liver/kidney/bone marrow instead of only the lungs?
map.肺直接接触溺液易假阳性，而肝/肾/骨髓硅藻需经体循环运输，阳性更具「生前吸入」特: The lungs contact the drowning fluid directly and easily give false positives, whereas diatoms in liver/kidney/bone marrow must travel through the systemic circulation, so a positive result is more specific to ante-mortem inhalation and is key to multi-organ consistency judgement.
